lines: The 827 shipped packages by licence: MIT 695, Apache-2.0 56, ISC 25, BSD-3-Clause 18, GPL-3.0-or-later 17, AGPL-3.0-or-later 4, BSD-2-Clause 3, 0BSD 2, and 7 licences more.
The app is under AGPL-3.0-only, as appinfo/info.xml declares; licences.json held each licence against it.
The advisories were not checked (NO_ADVISORIES=1 or --no-advisories): this report says nothing about vulnerable packages.
